Software Engineer, Database Internals — Neon

Location: Remote
Seniority: 0-2 years

About the role:
Help build a serverless Postgres platform. You will work on storage, query path
performance, and developer-facing database infrastructure.

Requirements:
- Strong CS fundamentals (data structures, concurrency, OS concepts)
- Experience with SQL and at least one systems language (Go, Rust, or C++)
- Interest in database internals, storage engines, or distributed systems
- Ability to write clear design docs and debug production issues

Preferred:
- Postgres contribution or extension experience
- Familiarity with MVCC, WAL, or replication concepts
- Prior work on data infrastructure

Domain: database, distributed systems, data infrastructure
